name: V-Sit
steps: Sit on the floor with your knees bent, lean your torso back slightly to balance squarely on your sit bones, and brace your abs tightly.
Lift and extend your legs straight upward at roughly a 45-degree angle so your torso and legs form a sharp V shape.
Reach both arms straight forward parallel to the floor alongside your knees while keeping your chest lifted and spine long.
Hold the balanced V position steadily while breathing smoothly for the target duration, then lower your feet gently back to the floor.
tips: Keep your chest proud and back flat rather than rounding into your lower back.
Bend your knees slightly to modify the hold if your lower back starts to feel strained.
